title: Unital identification of the finite coefficient tower
statement: For a prime l, scheme T, and an arbitrary section-preserving residue Restriction r [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-models], the underlying additive tower of r applied to the finite coefficient unit [def-sp-tower-class-coefficients] is isomorphic to the additive tower of the actual purTwistFiniteRing T l n. The isomorphism sends every section identified with coefficient one by r.underlying to one. This assertion has no root module, Chern data or completed projection.

source.place: paragraph (1), ordinary scalar restrictions before right derivation

proof.text: The extending spectral absolute value on ULift Q_l agrees with the original p-adic norm on every lifted element. Consequently the chosen valuation-one subring identifies, by the lifted identity, with Z_l. Map the ideal generated by l to the same principal ideal; its (n+1)-st power is the kernel of PadicInt.toZModPow (n+1). The surjective residue map gives the unital quotient-ring isomorphism with Z/l^(n+1).

These quotient-ring isomorphisms commute with quotient transitions because both maps take any integer representative to its residue. Apply constant sheafification and forget to additive sheaves. The section and restriction equations of r identify its coefficient-unit sheaves with the original additive coefficient sheaves; its transition equations identify the horizontal maps. Assemble a tower isomorphism. All ring maps preserve one, proving the required normalization.

theorem exists_diagonalTraceCoefficientIdentification (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (r : Restriction l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) T) :
    ∃ e : r.F.obj (coefficient T (Arings l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) T)) ⋙
        diagonalForget l T ≅
      Scheme.purTwistZlTower T l ⋙
        sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
          ((forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1}) ⋙
            forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}),
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (x : ((r.F.obj (coefficient T (Arings l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) T))).obj
          (op n)).obj.obj U),
        HEq x (1 : (SpTowerClasses.systemRing l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) T).obj.obj
          (op (n, U.unop))) →
        (e.hom.app (op n)).hom.app U x =
          (1 : (Scheme.purTwistFiniteRing T l n).obj.obj U)
